purpose: Run 3 adaptive research plan derived from Run 2 evidence. Each lane tests a different hypothesis; production source remains off-limits.

lanes.aider-direct: Acceptance-first materialisation with a preflight source read and a single-symbol edit.
lanes.aider-diff: Diff editing with a small map and an explicit no-prose acceptance check.
lanes.aider-udiff: Udiff with symbol-first targeting and refreshed source context.
lanes.aider-whole: Whole-file editing with a strict minimal-diff instruction and post-edit diff-size gate.
lanes.aider-scoped: Scoped editing against an exact function target and refreshed source context.
lanes.aider-architect: Architect planning followed by editor execution, measuring whether planning adds successful materialisation.
lanes.failure-replay: Replay the timeout/controller class with a bounded first attempt followed by bounded recovery.
lanes.performance-lab: Benchmark validation and preflight overhead separately from model time.
lanes.shadow-architecture: Test a disposable retry controller with one bounded retry and explicit telemetry.
lanes.adversarial: Test resistance to misleading instructions while requiring only the named target edit.
lanes.fast-deep: 45s fast attempt, validate actual file, then 120s deep escalation only on failed acceptance.
lanes.challenger: Generate falsifiable hypotheses about Run 2 sub-100ms Aider failures.
lanes.dependency-plan: Generate a dependency/target map and minimum untouched surface.
lanes.direct-ollama-json: Test structured JSON planning separately from deterministic materialisation.
lanes.openhands-sdk: Test SDK runtime/import separately from workspace editing.
lanes.evolution-selected: Test the latest Evolution hypothesis with explicit controller-vs-model failure measurement.
